description: We are a team of four enthusiastic engineering students participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. We are interested in space exploration, technology, innovation, and web development. Our goal is to build creative and user-friendly solutions through teamwork, problem-solving, and coding. We are excited to learn new technologies and develop an impactful project.
summary:
AgriSmart is an intelligent agriculture assistance system designed to help farmers make better farming decisions through smart technology. Our project integrates an underground soil monitoring hardware system with a web-based application to provide real-time agricultural information.

The hardware uses soil sensors to collect important soil parameters such as soil moisture and temperature. The collected sensor data is transmitted to our AgriSmart website, where farmers can monitor soil conditions through an interactive dashboard.

The platform also provides weather information, rainfall updates, soil health analysis, and AI-based crop recommendations according to soil and environmental conditions. It helps farmers identify suitable crops, understand their land conditions, and make informed agricultural decisions.

To make the system accessible to everyone, AgriSmart includes multilingual support for English, Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, and Malayalam, along with voice assistance for farmers who may have difficulty using text-based applications.

By combining IoT, AI, and multilingual technology, AgriSmart aims to reduce uncertainty in farming, improve resource management, and support smarter, more sustainable agriculture.
details:
AgriSmart – Smart Farming for a Sustainable Future

AgriSmart is a farmer-focused smart agriculture platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, addressing the challenge "Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data."

The main objective of AgriSmart is to help farmers make informed decisions about soil health, crop selection, and changing environmental conditions using agricultural technology, data analysis, and NASA Earth observation resources.

Our proposed system combines three major components:

1. Soil Monitoring: A proposed low-cost underground IoT monitoring system using soil sensors and an ESP32 controller to collect parameters such as soil moisture, temperature, pH, and NPK nutrient levels. Sensor integration with the live application is part of our planned hardware development.

2. NASA Earth Observation Data: AgriSmart is designed to incorporate NASA resources such as POWER for climate information, SMAP for soil moisture observations, and GPM for precipitation data. These datasets can help farmers understand changing weather and environmental conditions affecting their fields.

3. Intelligent Farmer Assistance: Our web application provides soil health information, temperature and rainfall updates, and AI-based crop recommendations using available agricultural and environmental information. It aims to help farmers identify suitable crops and make better-informed farming decisions.

AgriSmart also includes a farmer-friendly dashboard, voice assistance, and multilingual support for English, Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, and Malayalam, making agricultural information more accessible to farmers from different regions.

Technology Used:

- Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript

- Web application: Netlify hosting

- Proposed hardware: ESP32, soil monitoring sensors, and solar power

- Data sources: NASA POWER, SMAP, and GPM resources

- AI: Data analysis and crop recommendation assistance

- Development tools: AI-assisted development tools and web technologies

Innovation and Impact:

Unlike conventional farming information platforms that may provide general recommendations, AgriSmart aims to combine soil conditions, NASA Earth observation data, and crop guidance in one accessible platform. Its farmer-first design considers affordability, regional languages, ease of use, changing climate conditions, and the needs of small-scale farmers.

The expected impact includes improved agricultural awareness, more informed crop selection, better soil management, reduced unnecessary fertilizer use, and increased climate awareness among farmers.

Our long-term vision is to make data-driven agricultural assistance affordable, accessible, and useful for farming communities, supporting sustainable agriculture and climate-resilient farming.
